Creates or updates user records for OAuth-authenticated users (Google, GitHub, etc.). This endpoint is called by the frontend NextAuth callback to ensure OAuth users are stored in the backend database for consistency with credentials users. Protected by a shared secret header to prevent unauthorized access.

post.description: Sends a prompt to the AI service and retrieves the generated response

200.description: AI response stream using Server-Sent Events (SSE)

schema.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream following the AI SDK stream protocol. Each line starts with 'data: ' followed by a JSON object. The stream includes various event types: start, text-delta (incremental text chunks), tool calls, finish, etc. Stream ends with 'data: [DONE]'. Full protocol: https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/ai-sdk-ui/stream-protocol

simpleTextResponse.description: Basic streaming response with text only

responseWithToolCall.description: Streaming response that includes an AI tool call and subsequent response

value.error: Last message must be from the user
